facts.fact: StackAdapt's brand lift studies assess a DOOH campaign's impact on awareness, consideration, and purchase intent by surveying users exposed to the ads.

facts.fact: Footfall attribution measures how many people who saw a brand's DOOH ads in Las Vegas later visited the brand's store or a location of interest.
facts.quote: you can measure how many people saw your DOOH ads in Las Vegas and later visited your store or a location of interest

facts.fact: StackAdapt uses location data and its in-house identity graph to match users exposed to DOOH ads and retarget them on other programmatic channels such as native, display, and video.
